description: Defines a Time class for handling date and time operations, including conversions, formatting, and parsing in various formats. Also includes a TimeAsLocal class for local time handling.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Represents date and time with methods for parsing, formatting, and conversions, supporting both POSIX and Windows systems.

classes.name: TimeAsLocal
classes.description: Wraps a Time object to handle local time internally, providing conversion back to UTC and various time operations.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a Time object, supporting multiple date formats.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the Time object to a string in RFC1123 format.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the current Time.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts milliseconds from the current Time.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the Time object represents a valid date/time.

methods.name: ToLocal
methods.description: Converts UTC Time to local time.
